name: freeglm

metadata.description: Qwen multimodal understanding plugins — Agent Skills + MCP servers

plugins.name: freeglm-core
plugins.description: Read and visualize any file (images, video, docs, 3D, and more), plus image tools — crop, annotate, extract frames — as MCP tools.

plugins.name: freeglm-api
plugins.description: Cloud APIs for understanding media, by model family: VL (vision chat, OCR, grounding), Omni A/V (timestamped captioning, ASR / multi-speaker diarization, temporal grounding, event counting), plus ASR and segmentation (SAM3) — as MCP tools. VL runs on DashScope Qwen (default) or Zhipu GLM-4.6V-Flash (auto when only ZHIPU_API_KEY is set); Omni/ASR/segmentation on DashScope.

plugins.name: freeglm-search
plugins.description: Web + reverse-image search to confirm facts: web search, page extraction, reverse image search as MCP tools; currently supports Serper.

plugins.name: freeglm-video-memory
plugins.description: Hierarchical graph memory for long-video QA (build + query) as an MCP server.

plugins.name: freeglm-video-edit
plugins.description: ffmpeg-based video-editing workflows (skill) + image/video/audio generation as MCP tools.

plugins.name: freeglm-edu-agent
plugins.description: Educational tutorial-video generator (skill only): turn a math/science problem or image into a step-by-step Chinese explainer video or interactive page.

plugins.name: freeglm-blender
plugins.description: Blender 3D modeling: drive a live Blender (execute Python, screenshot the viewport, PolyHaven/Sketchfab/Hyper3D/Hunyuan3D assets) as MCP tools + a build→refine→verify skill. Needs a running Blender + addon.

plugins.name: freeglm-freecad
plugins.description: FreeCAD parametric CAD: create/edit objects, execute Python, named-view screenshots, parts library, and CalculiX FEM as MCP tools + a skill. Needs a running FreeCAD + addon.

description: FreeGLM multimodal capabilities for ZCode — derived from Qwen-MM-Plugins with a Zhipu GLM-4.6V-Flash vision backend
